SELECTED_INDEX: 9
CONFIDENCE: 0.20
EXPLANATION: Spectrum shows:  
• Very strong CH₃ C–H stretches at 2935 & 2880 cm⁻¹ and strong CH₃/CH₂ deformations at 1466–1442 cm⁻¹, consistent with a tertiary dimethylamino substituent (present in CN(C)CSN=O).  
• Two medium bands at 1499 cm⁻¹ and 1483 cm⁻¹ match the ν(N=O) stretching doublet typical of nitrosamine / S–N=O groups, which only candidate 9 contains.  
• An intense band at 920 cm⁻¹ fits the ν(S–N) stretch of sulfenamide / sulfinyl compounds, again unique to candidate 9.  
• A distinct C–S stretching band is expected near 650 cm⁻¹ (rule GFQ-032); the observed 654 cm⁻¹ peak supports the presence of an S–C bond in candidate 9.  
• Additional bands at 1007–1064 cm⁻¹ can be assigned to mixed S–N–O and C–N stretches of the dimethylamino-sulfenamide framework.

Among the candidates, only molecule 9 (CN(C)CSN=O) simultaneously provides:  
– Tertiary dimethylamine (explaining strong CH₃ features),  
– An S–N=O functional group giving characteristic Raman bands near 920 cm⁻¹ (S–N) and ~1500 cm⁻¹ (N=O),  
– A C–S bond giving the 654 cm⁻¹ band.  

Other candidates lack the N=O group (needed for the ~1500 cm⁻¹ doublet) or the S–N linkage (~920 cm⁻¹), making them less consistent with the key experimental peaks.
